rationale: The heartbeat account is the one whose decisive observation still rests on the fewest executions: its term-inversion rate comes from two runs of the fsync harness, 89 and 69 inversions in 200 attempts, and the zero-delay contrast from four jitter runs. Repeating cc2661ee13b14149b7ca04c9d5a35509-experiment from its retained inputs adds a third execution of the persisted-term surface, so a rate in the same band keeps the account's conclusion and its platform caveats as written while making the measured rate a three-point range, and a rate outside that band would directly reopen the claim that concurrent fast-path heartbeats can leave the node below a term it had adopted.
